description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.
The ID of the image search task. You can call [QueryPictureSearchJob](~~206778~~) to query the ID.

title.zh: 获取图片搜索任务状态

descriptions.zh:
一体化以图搜图，表示搜图时，同时检索人脸和人体特征。

> 该功能需要在V系列边缘一体机上部署人脸和人体检测算法。
descriptions.en:
Integrated image search indicates that both face and body features are retrieved simultaneously during the image search.

> This feature requires the deployment of face and body detection algorithms on V-series edge devices.
